title: Hanasato Minori — The Hasty Messenger〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, Haruka and I are gonna start working out all the details for the graduation event.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sound good! In the meantime, Shizuku and I will try to come up with lots and lots of quiz questions.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We may also want to give them some extra space to work.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So I guess we're gonna have to ask the teachers to take over behind the camera for our stream...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right.
How should we handle their angles and positions?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll be moving around quite a bit, so it'd be strange to have them all locked into place.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's true too...
What if we did something like this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Those two are so amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It's like they know exactly how to make an event as fun as it can be and where we need to be careful.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I hope that I'll be able to hold discussions like that with everyone someday...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (No, I shouldn't hope! I have to believe that I will!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And I have to make sure I do as well as I can right now to make that happen!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, shall we start working on the quiz section?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem very excited about this, Minori. I promise to try my best too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's begin with... Oh, Minori, have you had a chance to look through the reference materials we have about the elementary school we'll be visiting or its website?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm all set!
We're supposed to base the true or false quiz on that, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. In that case, why don't we start coming up with some questions?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hmm... This is harder than I thought it would be...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (These questions need to be easy enough so that elementary school students can answer, but we can't make them too easy either...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'll try checking the school's website again. Now, where did I put my phone...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, this must be...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hey, Minori, Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MEIKO! Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Sorry for the sudden interruption. We were wondering how things were going in terms of preparing for that event.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You came at just the right time. We happen to be working on that right now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi and Haruka are working on how we'll actually be streaming this event along with scheduling and such...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And we're in the middle of coming up with quiz questions.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, you said you're doing a true or false quiz with everyone... And it's all about the school, right?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do you think about having Miku and MEIKO look through our quiz questions, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've come up with a few already, but don't really feel all that great about them...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's a wonderful idea!
Would you two be okay with that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Sure, sounds fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Okay, here's my first question...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Any thoughts...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I thought it was very fun!
My favorite was the one about the school being founded 500 years ago.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I liked the question about the school trip and how it's designed to have the older students know the answer.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You did?! Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, but...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Was there something that caught your attention?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Well, it's nothing that major...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's totally okay!
I want to hear all of your suggestions!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This might be the only significant contribution I'll be able to make for this event!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <In that case... About the question that says the school was founded 500 years ago...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The little ones may know what the number 500 is, but may not be able to comprehend just how long 500 years is...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I see... The fifth and sixth-graders may be the only ones that can imagine what this area was like 500 years ago based on historical dating...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Right. I don't think it's necessarily bad in terms of a true or false quiz, but...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (500 years ago would've been the Azuchi-Momoyama era, right? That means...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know! What if we rewrote it to say that the school was made when there were lots and lots of samurai still around?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, that sounds much better!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I agree. This should help give the little ones a better idea of what the question's asking!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think so too! Great idea, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, you should be thanking Miku for making such great suggestions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think the rest of our questions should also be written like this. What do you think, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree completely!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I'll help you two out as best I can♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Me too!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm gonna do everything I can to make this as fun as it can be!)
